title: trichodium capillare
intro: Trichodium capillare, commonly known as Witch's Hair Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Trichodium capillare include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
